action: Audited the durable evidence without executing any backtest: read state/LEARNING_STATE.md (frontier table, learning history, rules), state/STATE.md (activation sections 37263008074 through 37414038601 and the pre-frontier MA-crossover sections), logs/ACTIVATION-2026-10-05.md and ACTIVATION-2026-10-06.md, state/activation_status.json, the current controller state (state/campaign/task_queue.json, current_task.json, runs/44585034006/campaign_status.json, agents/agent_01_contract.json), and the selector implementation in .github/scripts/campaign_controller.py (task_rank, candidate_tasks_for_role, select_task) with its validation contract in .github/scripts/validate_campaign_agent.py. Recomputed the selector's ordering by hand from task_rank over all six role-eligible OPEN LEARNING_PROCESS tasks to test whether the recorded selection is reproducible from durable state. Compared the pre-frontier selection pattern (opportunistic queue sourcing, 4 consecutive activations refining an already-falsified MA-crossover cell, one activation producing no verdict) against the frontier-first pattern (6 distinct cells, decisive verdicts, independent verification, no equivalent re-tests). Found and documented two selection/closure record defects, then added the minimal durable process rule (learning rule 8) and a provenance caveat to the affected frontier row. No controller code, queue, workflow, or protected path was modified.

observed_effect: The selector is deterministic and reproducible from durable queue state (verified by hand-recomputation of task_rank), and under it the frontier produced six decisively closed, non-duplicated cells with pre-declared objectives, versus a documented prior pattern of four consecutive activations refining an already-falsified MA-crossover cell plus one activation that produced no verdict. The audit's concrete product is auditability: the reconstructibility requirement that was missing is now durable rule 8, and the one untraceable closure is explicitly flagged rather than silently accepted. The magnitude of any efficiency gain remains unmeasured.
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection improves information flow relative to the repository's prior opportunistic task choice, and whether the selection record is independently auditable.
uncertainty_reduced: Selection mechanism shown deterministic and reproducible from durable state (removes the 'unauditable selector' concern); allocation pattern contrasted with the prior opportunistic regime using cited activations (removes the 'no observable difference' concern); two record-completeness defects documented and a minimal durable rule added (converts a silent traceability gap into a checkable requirement). The causal efficiency claim is deliberately left UNVERIFIED rather than asserted, so the remaining uncertainty is now named precisely: queue-label authorship and gate-stack confounding.
research_result: No new market evidence and no re-executed experiment: this is a LEARNING_PROCESS audit that consumed existing durable artifacts only (cross_sectional_momentum_results.json, momentum_results.json, breakout_20day_cont_results.json, volatility_targeting_results.json, mean_reversion_results.json, LEARNING_STATE/STATE/activation records).
